text: Some of the staff were friendly, but the dentist overcharged for X-rays and CT scans. I have a new sore in my mouth that won't heal. It's been a week, and I'm paying $10,000 for the X-rays, CT scans, and impressions. I'm American; I understand that dentists' prices are exorbitant. I just needed new dentures. The dentist said $50,000 in America is too expensive. Dentures cost $300 each for upper and lower teeth, but this dentist wanted me to pay $1,440 = $50,000 after I'd already paid $10,000 for the X-rays, dental impressions, and CT scans. And now I have a sore in my mouth from the CT scan. I think that's a terrible way to treat new patients! Apart from that, the staff were nice and polite! I've lost hundreds of dollars and have a new sore, and I'm also having trouble getting my new dentures fitted!
